task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! First stop, travel east. And then, pick up the cake scented latchkey from the floor of the recreation zone. After that, venture west. And then, unlock the cake scented portal. After that, make absolutely sure that the cake scented portal is open. And then, take a trip south. Following that, move south. After that, attempt to take a trip east. Then, take a trip east. Then, assure that the gateway is ajar. After pulling open the gateway, make an attempt to go to the north. If you can finish that, try to venture north. And then, move north. If you can get around to doing that, pick-up the sandwich from the floor of the chamber. Got that? Good!
